notes: Shopify storefront (canonical host thebombaystore.com, robots.txt fully Allow:/ for all agents, Claude explicitly permitted). Investigated via direct HTTP: robots.txt, sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (enumerated all ~220 collection URLs), homepage nav link scan, products.json per collection, and HTML product-link enumeration for tag-filtered pages that lack a products.json endpoint. Total catalog = 1568 products (from /collections/all). DIWALI (given priority per task): no standalone /collections/diwali* page exists (tested diwali, diwali-gifting, diwali-collection, diwali-gifts, diwali-decor, diwali-lighting, diwali-2024/2025 as base collections - all 404), BUT the site actively uses a real product tag 'Diwali Gifting' exposed via Shopify's tag-filter URL pattern /collections/all/diwali-gifting (108 products, verified by enumerating product links across all 3 result pages = exactly 108 unique slugs). Verified this is genuine merchandising taxonomy, not an auto-generated/fake slug: ran a negative-control test with a nonsense slug (zzznonsensequux123) and every other holiday name in the same tag-URL pattern (mothers-day, raksha-bandhan literal, valentines-day, holi, christmas, eid, new-year, thanksgiving, easter, halloween - tried bare, with 'shop-by-occasion-' prefix, and with '-gifting' suffix) - ALL of these 301-redirect to /collections/all because the tag doesn't exist, while 'diwali-gifting' alone returns 200 with real paginated content. Sampled the 108 products: roughly half are core Diwali items (brass deepaks/diyas in many styles, Laxmi deepaks, urlis, Ganesh-Laxmi temple bells, aarti deepaks, tealight/votive holders, Diwali candles, puja chowkis) and the remainder are generic gift items (diaries, wallets, laptop cases, wall hangings, drinkware) also carrying the tag - a genuine but diluted occasion tag, not a wholesale mislabeled generic catalog (108/1568=6.9% of catalog, well under the >20-30% red-flag threshold). Independently corroborated via /search/suggest.json?q=diwali - top product (Brass Deep Laxmi) description text explicitly states 'perfect for Diwali, Lakshmi Pooja'. CHRISTMAS: real named collection /collections/christmas exists (h1 'Christmas', 48 products) but full product-list sampling found ZERO genuinely Christmas-specific items (no ornaments, trees, Santa, wreaths, stockings, snowmen) - contents are generic dining/lighting/tealight/gifting items, many of which independently carry the 'Diwali Gifting' tag - this is the exact generic-catalog-mislabeled-as-holiday pattern flagged in task instructions, so EXCLUDED. FESTIVALS: /collections/festivals (568 products = 36% of total catalog, over the red-flag threshold) and FESTIVE FAVOURITES: /collections/festive-favourites-2 (261 products = 16.6%) both sampled and found to be broad generic home-decor/gifting grouping pages (wall hangings, cushion covers, trays, mugs) with no single-holiday theming - EXCLUDED as oversized generic grouping catalogs, not genuine single-holiday categories (/collections/festive-favourites-1 was empty/0 products; base /collections/festive-favourites 404s). FATHER'S DAY: /collections/fathers-day is a real but empty (0 products) landing page - excluded, not a valid PLP. /collections/fathers-day-collection (h1 'Fathers Day Collection', 9 products) is real and only 2/9 products overlap with the generic 'Shop by Occasion - For Him' collection (45 products) - i.e. 78% distinctly curated - included but flagged since none of the 9 items carry explicit father/dad theming or personalization (brass singing bowl, leather diary cases, coffee mug sets, wooden chess sets, city-print mugs read as generic premium 'gifts for him'). MOTHER'S DAY: no collection, no tag (search/suggest.json?q=mother returns zero collections), not in sitemap or nav at all - genuinely absent. RAKSHA BANDHAN: /collections/rakshabandhan-gifts-for-sister (h1 'Raksha Bandhan Gifts', 15 products) is real and only 3/15 overlap with the generic 'Shop by Occasion - For Her' collection (46 products) - 80% distinctly curated - included; no literal rakhi-thread products but genuinely curated sister-gifting set under the site's own Raksha Bandhan label, flagged accordingly. There is also a distinct 'Shop by Occasion - Raksha Bandhan' product tag (confirmed to exist via the /collections/all/shop-by-occasion-raksha-bandhan tag URL returning 200) that overlaps with but is not identical to this named collection; not double-counted. RAM NAVAMI: /collections/ram-navami-collection (7 products) - all 7 are Ram Darbar figurines / Ram Mandir replica / Ram-themed keychain, 100% content-verified as genuinely festival-specific - included. HOLI, NEW YEAR, VALENTINE'S DAY, EASTER, HALLOWEEN, EID, THANKSGIVING, NAVRATRI, DUSSEHRA, ONAM, PONGAL, BAISAKHI, JANMASHTAMI, UGADI, GUDI PADWA, REPUBLIC DAY, INDEPENDENCE DAY: tested as both standalone collections (all 404) and as tag-filter URLs in multiple slug variants (all 301-redirect to /collections/all, confirming the tag does not exist) - genuinely absent from this site's taxonomy despite the brand's gifting heritage. Excluded as out-of-scope (not seasonal/holiday, personal-occasion categories per task rules): Birthday, Anniversary, Corporate, Wedding, House Warming, For Him, For Her (all under 'Shop by Occasion'). Excluded as generic product-type taxonomy that merely overlaps with Diwali shopping but carries no holiday label from the site itself: Diyas, Puja Items, Toran Hangings, Ganeshas/Ganesha (brass/wood/resin/metal-enamel variants), Home Accents - Diyas, Home Accents - Toran and Hangings. ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): removed the 'Fathers Day Collection' row (9 items, https://thebombaystore.com/collections/fathers-day-collection) - none of the 9 sampled products carried any explicit father/dad theming, branding, or personalization (brass singing bowl, diary cases, mug sets, chess sets, city-print mugs), and unlike the kept Raksha Bandhan Gifts row there was no compensating occasion-specific marketing framing, matching the generic-catalog-mislabeled-as-holiday pattern.

rows.evidence: Site's own 'Diwali Gifting' product tag exposed as a filtered PLP; 108 unique products verified by enumerating product links across all 3 result pages. Sample includes deepaks/diyas (multiple brass deepak/annam-deepak variants), Laxmi deepaks, urlis, Ganesh-Laxmi temple bells, aarti deepaks, tealight/votive holders, Diwali candles, puja chowkis - core Diwali items - mixed with generic gift items (diaries, wallets, wall hangings) also carrying the tag. Verified as genuine active taxonomy (not autogenerated) via negative-control test against 20+ nonsense/other-holiday slugs, all of which 301-redirect while this one returns 200. Search-suggest result independently shows a top Diwali-tagged product's description text explicitly referencing 'Diwali, Lakshmi Pooja'.

Genuine named collection (h1 'Raksha Bandhan Gifts'); only 3 of 15 products overlap with the generic 'Shop by Occasion - For Her' collection (46 products), i.e. 80% distinctly curated for this occasion. Contents: wallets, brass rickshaw, tea mug set, coasters, scarves/stoles, diary, coffee mugs, wood art frames, tote bag, bobble head figurine.
rows.flag: ADJUDICATED KEEP: irreducible ambiguity - no literal rakhi/thread products, but the page carries explicit sister-gift occasion framing and is 80% distinctly curated from the generic 'For Her' collection under the site's own Raksha Bandhan label. Kept on the strength of the occasion-specific framing.
